opening.argument: The video presents an official rock performance centered on musicians entertaining an audience, not a request for investment, payment, credentials, or personal information. Its title identifies it as an “Official Music Video,” and the footage shows a band performing onstage while the audio invites listeners to “give them a show!” The associated offers are ordinary entertainment promotions: the description directs viewers to obtain the first single from The Relentless and advertises “TICKETS ON SALE NOW” for the related film. Those details are consistent with music merchandising and film promotion, without establishing a scheme to acquire money or data through deceptive means.
